title: Chord sets back in key, still twelve and smooth
thisBuild: Chord sets stay in key again. Every set still has 12 chords: the seven chords of its scale, then five colour chords (sus, add9, sevenths) that are in key too.
Keys in the scale play their own chord: press A in C major and you get A minor. The five keys between play the colour chords, so every key does something and nothing is out of key.
Picking a set written in another scale moves the scale to it again, and the menu says so.
Smooth moves stays on: each chord picks the inversion nearest the last one, so changes glide.
watch: Play Sunday Pop or Neo Soul on the chord boxes: in key and smooth now?
Do the colour chords on the black keys feel useful, or would you rather those keys stay quiet?
Any set that still feels off? Tell me which set and which chord.
limits: The Roll still writes chords from their root.
Making your own sets isn't in yet.
The cut and look changes are still proposals: nothing moved on screen in this build.
